cover.alt: Illustrated Hymdaihlu cover with a lantern, hymnbook, and mountain dawn

intro.summary: A large Rongmei hymn collection imported from the Hymdaihlu legacy song database.
intro.description: Browse and search 930 imported hymns. Source book and hymn numbers, tune details, meter, chords, and author information are retained as searchable metadata when present.

credits.publisher: Source publisher not recorded in the database
credits.rights: Song and image rights remain with their respective authors, translators, compilers, publishers, and rights holders. Import does not change ownership.

changelog.note: Replaced English database titles with verified RongmeiIndexes titles, preserved alternate Rongmei titles for search, and aligned catalog numbers with source pages.
Imported 930 records from two source book types; duplicate source numbering is preserved in metadata while app catalog numbers remain unique.
